cenarios.desc: wide panoramic view of a football stadium pitch seen from the side, NO people at all: flat green grass with white pitch lines filling the bottom half, a goal to the right, and behind the pitch a tall packed stand of blurred cream and dark seats. The GROUND LINE is continuous and unobstructed across the whole width, and the lower third of the image is empty grass with nothing standing on it

a narrow horizontal band of OUT-OF-FOCUS dark green grass blades running along the very BOTTOM edge of the frame only, occupying just the bottom 5 percent of the image height, plus one thin corner-flag pole with a small plain triangular flag standing at the far LEFT edge and another at the far RIGHT edge. The middle and the whole upper area are completely empty
